query_text: A post-surgery recovery reminder app for my phone that walks me through each step of the protocol my doctor gave me, things like wound care, medication timing, and gentle movement exercises, all laid out in a clear daily checklist I can tap through one step at a time, with a spot to note how I am feeling each day so I can track my recovery progress.

Need a mental health self-care routine checker for my phone that lets me tick off the things I want to do each day, like going outside, drinking enough water, journaling, and getting to bed on time, with a simple way to see how consistent I have been over the past week so I can stay on top of my routine.

Make a daily skincare reminder app I can use on my phone that lists each step of my morning and evening routine in order, like cleanser, toner, serum, and moisturizer, so I can tap each one done as I go and never skip a step, with a way to set the times I want reminders to pop up for both routines.

Create a diabetic insulin injection schedule app for my phone that helps me keep track of each shot, including the time, the type of insulin, and the dose, all in a simple list I can add to quickly throughout the day, with a history I can scroll back through to show my doctor at the next appointment.

Create a stretching break alert app for my phone that reminds me to get up from my desk at set intervals during the workday, like every hour or every 90 minutes, and shows me a short list of stretches to do each time, with a simple tap to mark the break done and move on.

Build a competition prep countdown planner for my phone that shows how many weeks are left until race day and breaks my training into a week-by-week plan leading up to the event, with each week listing the key workouts and targets I need to hit, so I always know exactly where I am in my prep.

A seasonal sport training logger for my phone that lets me record my sessions throughout the season, including the date, duration, and what I worked on, grouped by month so I can look back and see how my training built up over time, with a spot to write a short note about how each session felt.

Create a strength training logger for my phone that lets me record each exercise I do, the number of sets, the reps for each set, and the weight I used, all in a clean list I can fill in quickly between sets, with a way to pull up my numbers from the last time I did the same workout.

Build a marathon training tracker for my phone that lays out my weekly running plan from now until race day, showing the scheduled runs for each day of the week, with the ability to log my actual distance and time after each run so I can see how closely I am following the plan week by week.

Create a CrossFit workout-of-the-day score and record logger I can use on my phone right after class, where I can enter the workout name, my finishing time or rep count, and any notes about how it went, and then see a list of all my past results for that same workout so I can track my improvement over time.

Create a cycling tracker for my phone that lets me log each ride with the route name, distance I covered, and how long it took, and then shows my average speed calculated automatically, with a list of all my past rides I can scroll through to see which routes I am getting faster on.

Make a swimming lap counter app I can use at the pool on my phone, where I tap a big button each time I finish a lap so it counts them up automatically, and I can also see my total distance for the session and how long I have been in the water, with a history of past swim sessions to look back on.

A yoga flow logger for my phone where I can record each session by listing the poses I did in order, how long I held each one, and any notes about what I want to try differently next time, so I can build up a library of my own sequences and pick one to follow on the next time I practice.

Need a rock climbing route tracker for my phone that lets me log each route I attempt, with the grade, the crag or gym name, whether I completed it, and a quick note about how the climb went, and then shows me a summary of which grade range I am climbing most often so I can see myself improving.

Make a dance practice logger for my phone that lets me record each session with the piece or routine I worked on, how long I practiced, and which parts I focused on, with a running list of all my sessions so I can look back and see how much time I have put into learning each choreography.

Build a mobile app that helps me track my weight and my menstrual cycle together on the same calendar, so I can spot patterns between where I am in my cycle and how my weight shifts, with daily log entries for weight and cycle day, and a simple chart that shows both things lined up over the past month.

Make a sleep coaching milestone tracker I can use on my phone to follow a multi-week programme for improving my sleep, where each week has a list of habits or targets to work on, and I can tick off each one as I do it, with a progress bar showing how far through the programme I am.

Build a morning weigh-in tracker for my phone where I enter my weight each day and it draws a simple line chart showing how my weight has changed over the past month, with my current weight and a note of the highest and lowest readings, so I can see the overall trend clearly without getting caught up in daily ups and downs.

Make a menstrual cycle and fertile window calendar app for my phone that lets me log the start and end of each period, and then shows the next expected cycle and the days likely to be the fertile window highlighted right on a calendar, with a spot to add notes about symptoms for each day.

A sleep quality tracker for my phone where I log each night's sleep by entering what time I went to bed, what time I woke up, and how rested I feel on a simple scale, and the app shows a chart of my sleep duration and quality scores over the past two weeks so I can see which nights I slept well and which I did not.

Need a body measurement log I can use on my phone to record my tape measurements every couple of weeks, things like waist, hips, chest, and arms, with a history of past entries so I can see the numbers changing over time, and a way to set which measurements I care about tracking.

An intermittent fasting tracker app for my phone that shows a timer counting down my current eating window or fasting window, lets me set which fasting protocol I am following like 16/8 or 18/6, and keeps a log of each completed fast with the start time, end time, and total hours, so I can see my streak of consistent fasting days.

Need a blood glucose log for my phone that lets me record my readings throughout the day, including the time, the reading value, and whether it was taken before or after a meal, all saved in a clean list I can scroll through, with a way to see my average reading over the past seven days at a glance.

Need a blood pressure and heart rate logger for my phone that lets me enter my systolic, diastolic, and pulse numbers each time I measure, with the date and time saved automatically, and a chart showing how my readings have trended over the past month so I can bring a clear picture to my next checkup.

Build a body fat percentage tracker for my phone where I can log my body fat reading every week or two, along with my weight, and see a line chart showing how both numbers are changing over time, with my starting point clearly marked so I can see how much progress I have made since I began.
